blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Laws made under Articles 2 and 3 do not require the constitutional amendment procedure under Article 368.
Initial state organisation in India was based purely on administrative convenience.
The States Reorganisation Act, 1956 shifted the criterion of state reorganisation to a linguistic basis.
Andhra Pradesh was created in 1953 as the first state formed on a linguistic basis.
Telangana, established in 2014, is the newest state in India.

Andhra Pradesh (1953) was the FIRST state created on a linguistic basis.
States Reorganisation Act, 1956 established Language as the primary basis for state formation.
Formation years of key states: Gujarat & Maharashtra (1960), Haryana (1966), Himachal Pradesh (1971), Uttarakhand/Jharkhand/Chhattisgarh (2000), Telangana (2014).
